stem.text: The reaction pathway for the forward reaction of a reversible reaction is shown.

stem.alt: Energy profile: energy in kJ mol-1 against progress of reaction. The curve starts at a reactant level, rises to a peak 30 kJ mol-1 above that level, then falls to a product level 50 kJ mol-1 below the reactant level.

A.text: The activation energy of the reverse reaction is $+80\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.

B.text: The enthalpy change for the forward reaction is $+30\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.

C.text: The enthalpy change for the forward reaction is $+50\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.

D.text: The enthalpy change for the reverse reaction is $+30\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.
